ValidationRule.description: This rule requires that a product status is required prior to saving the lead record. This rule is specific to the Lease product status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( And( ISBLANK( FPC_Rep_Lease__c ),NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_Lease__c )))), AND( NOT(ISBLANK( FPC_Rep_Lease__c )),ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_Lease__c ))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If FPC Rep Lease is populated the Status Lease is required.
